explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/711: prove max_m (f(n,m) − f(n,n)) → ∞ (done by van Doorn). The statement says: for every B, for all large n, there are m and the minimal lengths Lm = f(n,m), Ln = f(n,n) (via IsMinimalIntervalLength) with B ≤ Lm − Ln. Truncated subtraction is harmless, since for B ≥ 1 it forces Lm ≥ Ln + B. Faithful.
